species: The SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant (hCoV-19/Hangzhou/ZJU-12/2021) was collected on May 2021 from the sputum samples of a COVID-19 patient in Zhoushan, Zhejiang province, and was the first isolated Delta variant in China (GISAID: EPI_ISL_3127444.2).
